name: parse_error_bare_word
description: Step 1: a bare word is not JSON. Answered with -32700 and id null, even before hello.

name: parse_error_truncated
description: Step 1: a truncated object is not JSON.

name: parse_error_empty_frame
description: Step 1: an empty text frame is not JSON.

name: parse_error_trailing_garbage
description: Step 1: a valid request followed by garbage is not strict JSON, so the request inside is not answered; the id is null.

name: parse_error_two_objects
description: Step 1: two concatenated objects in one frame are not one JSON value.

name: parse_error_nan
description: Step 1: NaN is not a JSON number (some parsers accept it by default).

name: parse_error_unquoted_string
description: Step 1: an unquoted word as a member value is not strict JSON (lenient parsers accept it).

name: parse_error_single_quotes
description: Step 1: single-quoted strings are not strict JSON.

name: parse_error_trailing_comma
description: Step 1: a trailing comma is not strict JSON.

name: surrounding_whitespace_ok
description: Whitespace around the JSON value is allowed by RFC 8259; the request is answered normally.

name: batch_array
description: Step 2: a JSON-RPC batch array is not supported (spec section 1); -32600 with id null, nothing inside is executed.

name: batch_array_before_hello
description: Step 2 before step 5: a batch containing a hello is still -32600, not a hello.

name: empty_array
description: Step 2: an empty array is not an object.

name: scalar_number
description: Step 2: a JSON number is not an object.

name: scalar_string
description: Step 2: a JSON string is not an object.

name: scalar_null
description: Step 2: JSON null is not an object.

name: notification_ignored
description: Step 3: a well-formed request without id is a notification; none are defined, so it is ignored.

name: notification_empty_object
description: Step 3: {} has no id member, so it is ignored rather than rejected.

name: notification_wrong_jsonrpc
description: Step 3 before step 4: no id, so a wrong jsonrpc version is not reported.

name: notification_method_not_string
description: Step 3 before step 4: no id, so a non-string method is not reported.

name: notification_without_method
description: Step 3 before step 4: no id and no method is still just ignored.

name: notification_bad_params
description: Step 3 before step 7: no id, so params that are not an object are not reported.

name: notification_before_hello
description: Step 3 before step 5: no id, so a missing hello is not reported either.

name: notification_hello_does_not_count
description: A hello sent as a notification is ignored entirely: it does not complete the handshake.

name: id_float_one
description: Step 4: 1.0 is not an integer literal; -32600 with id null because the id is invalid.

name: id_exponent
description: Step 4: 1e3 has an exponent and is rejected.

name: id_fraction
description: Step 4: a fractional id is rejected.

name: id_null
description: Step 4: id null is present (so not a notification) but invalid: a deliberate tightening of JSON-RPC.

name: id_two_pow_53
description: Step 4: 2^53 is outside the signed 53-bit range.

name: id_minus_two_pow_53
description: Step 4: -2^53 is outside the signed 53-bit range.

name: id_max_safe_integer
description: 2^53-1 is the largest valid integer id and is echoed exactly.

name: id_boolean
description: Step 4: a boolean id is rejected.

name: id_object
description: Step 4: an object id is rejected.

name: id_string_ok
description: String ids are echoed as strings, including the empty string.

name: id_negative_ok
description: Negative integer ids are valid.

name: jsonrpc_wrong_version
description: Step 4: jsonrpc "1.0" with a valid id is -32600; the valid id is echoed.

name: jsonrpc_missing
description: Step 4: a request without jsonrpc is -32600.

name: jsonrpc_number
description: Step 4: jsonrpc must be the string "2.0", not the number 2.0.

name: method_missing
description: Step 4: an object with an id but no method is -32600.

name: method_not_string
description: Step 4: a non-string method is -32600.

name: invalid_id_and_jsonrpc
description: Step 4: with both id and jsonrpc invalid the id can't be echoed, so it is null.

name: invalid_request_before_hello
description: Step 4 before step 5: a wrong jsonrpc version before hello is -32600, not -32003.

name: invalid_id_hello
description: Step 4 before step 5: a hello with id null is -32600 and does not complete the handshake.

name: hello_required
description: Step 5: a known method before hello is -32003.

name: hello_required_before_unknown_method
description: Step 5 before step 6: an unknown method before hello is -32003, not -32601.

name: hello_required_before_bad_params
description: Step 5 before step 7: params that are not an object, before hello, are -32003, not -32602.

name: hello_required_before_unknown_source
description: Step 5 before step 8: subscribing to an unknown source before hello is -32003.

name: hello_method_is_case_sensitive
description: Step 5: "HELLO" is not hello, so it is gated like any other method.

name: hello_ok
description: A valid hello as the first request succeeds.

name: hello_repeated
description: A second hello after a successful one is allowed.

name: hello_unknown_members_ignored
description: Unknown members in hello params (and in client) are ignored.

name: hello_unsupported_protocol
description: Step 8: an unsupported protocol is -32004 with data.supported.

name: failed_hello_does_not_complete_handshake
description: After only a failed hello, other methods are still -32003.

name: failed_hello_keeps_earlier_success
description: A failed hello does not undo an earlier successful one.

name: hello_missing_protocol
description: Step 7: hello without protocol is -32602.

name: hello_protocol_not_string
description: Step 7 before step 8: a non-string protocol is -32602, not -32004.

name: hello_params_null
description: Step 7: params null is treated as absent, so protocol is missing.

name: hello_params_array
description: Step 7: hello is never gated, so array params are -32602.

name: unknown_method
description: Step 6: an unknown method after hello is -32601.

name: unknown_method_before_bad_params
description: Step 6 before step 7: an unknown method with array params is -32601, not -32602.

name: method_empty_string
description: Step 6: the empty string is a string (so step 4 passes) but not a method.

name: method_event_from_client
description: Step 6: event is a server notification, not a method a client can call.

name: params_null_is_absent
description: Step 7: params null is treated as absent; list_sensors needs none.

name: params_unknown_members_ignored
description: Unknown members in params are ignored.

name: params_array
description: Step 7: array params are -32602, even for a method that takes none.

name: params_scalar
description: Step 7: scalar params are -32602.

name: subscribe_params_null
description: Step 7: subscribe with params null is the same as no params, so source is missing.

name: subscribe_source_not_string
description: Step 7: a non-string source is -32602, not -32001.

name: subscribe_rate_zero_on_change
description: Step 7: rate_hz must be > 0 for any source, even on_change ones where it is otherwise ignored.

name: subscribe_rate_negative
description: Step 7: a negative rate_hz is -32602.

name: subscribe_rate_not_number
description: Step 7: a string rate_hz is -32602.

name: subscribe_min_delta_negative
description: Step 7: min_delta must be >= 0.

name: subscribe_bad_params_before_unknown_source
description: Step 7 before step 8: rate_hz 0 on an unknown source is -32602, not -32001.

name: subscribe_bad_params_before_unavailable
description: Step 7 before step 8: rate_hz 0 on an unavailable source is -32602, not -32002.

name: subscribe_unknown_source
description: Step 8: a source not in the catalog is -32001.

name: subscribe_unknown_source_and_type
description: Step 8: a type can only be checked against a known source, so an unknown source wins.

name: subscribe_unknown_type
description: Step 8: a type the source does not have is -32602.

name: subscribe_unavailable
description: Step 8: a known but unavailable source is -32002.

name: subscribe_unknown_type_before_unavailable
description: Step 8: an unknown type on an unavailable source is -32602 (invalid params are reported before device state).

name: subscribe_on_change_ignores_rate
description: A positive rate_hz on an on_change source is accepted and ignored.

name: get_ok
description: get with a matching type returns a reading.

name: get_type_not_string
description: Step 7: a non-string type is -32602.

name: get_missing_source
description: Step 7: get without source is -32602.

name: get_unknown_source
description: Step 8: get on a source not in the catalog is -32001.

name: get_unknown_type
description: Step 8: get with a type the source does not have is -32602.

name: get_unavailable
description: Step 8: get on an unavailable source is -32002.

name: get_no_value
description: Step 8: get on a source with no value yet (ui before any tap) is -32006.

name: get_no_value_nfc
description: Step 8: nfc is event-like too; before any tag is scanned, get is -32006.

name: unsubscribe_missing_subscription
description: Step 7: unsubscribe without subscription is -32602.

name: unsubscribe_subscription_not_string
description: Step 7: a non-string subscription is -32602, not -32005.

name: unsubscribe_unknown
description: Step 8: a subscription id that is not in this session is -32005.

name: binary_frame
description: Binary frames are reserved: the server closes with 1003.

name: binary_frame_before_hello
description: A binary frame closes with 1003 even before hello, whatever its content.

name: request_approval_dev_mode
description: APPROVAL.md §1: approval exists only in secure mode; in dev mode request_approval is an unknown method, even with valid params.
